points.description: Names the method of moments (equating sample moments to population/distribution moments) as one method.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely named (e.g. 'moments' with no method, or clearly garbled name).

points.description: Names the method of maximum likelihood (maximum likelihood estimation) as the second method.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely named (e.g. 'likelihood' alone or garbled name).

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming both method of moments and method of maximum likelihood; each is worth 1 mark, in any order. Clear synonyms like 'moment method' or 'MLE' are accepted. A wrong extra method does not cancel a correct one, but a wrong item earns nothing for its slot.
